name: ManiSkill panda PlaceSphere-v1 motion planner
summary: Pick up a sphere and place it into a bin with the official Panda planner.

license.scope: Upstream ManiSkill code; hub wrapper and metadata use the hub LICENSE.

observation.description: Reads ground-truth object poses, collision geometry and robot state directly from the simulator. Not an RGB-only policy.

hardware: Linux x86_64 CPU; SAPIEN wheel needs glibc >=2.28
requirements.rendering: Output rendering disabled: render_backend=none, render_mode=None, state observations and CPU simulation. Pinned SAPIEN material initialization may still require a usable Vulkan ICD. CPU Mesa lavapipe initialization was verified for the initial PickCube/StackCube recipes, not for this task.
network: PyPI and dependency distributions; source package build hooks may execute
requirements.dependency_lock: Direct dependencies pinned; transitive dependencies resolved by pip and captured in the prepared project. No bit-for-bit environment guarantee.

completion.success_condition: PlaceSphere-v1 env info.success is true after the upstream solver finishes, truncated is false, and 0 < elapsed_steps < max_episode_steps=1000; only then status is task_complete and exit is 0. The 1000-step motion-planning horizon is a Hub recipe condition, not the upstream default benchmark horizon.
failure_modes: Required Linux mplib wheels unavailable on host OS
Motion planning reports failure or env info.success is false
Runtime exception or asset download failure
Episode truncated or elapsed_steps reaches the Hub 1000-step horizon
completion.stop_condition: Stop after one seed; no automatic retries. Use an external 300-second process timeout.

evidence.result: Inspected the pinned solver signature, task registration, source license and wrapper contract. No simulator invocation evidence is attached. Version 1.1.0 explicitly sets a Hub 1000-step horizon and rejects truncated results; this updated wrapper has not been run in a simulator.

contribution.instructions: Only actual reusable fixes. Public submission permission and a scoped pilot token are separate requirements. Submission opens a public internal draft PR; it is not publication.

seed.description: Simulation reset seed; task, robot, controller, state observation and 1000-step horizon are fixed by this recipe.

preconditions: Use the exact declared runtime/robot/environment combination.
Ground-truth state and environment-generated targets; this adapter accepts a seed, not an arbitrary Cartesian goal.
postconditions: PlaceSphere-v1 env info.success is true after the upstream solver finishes, truncated is false, and 0 < elapsed_steps < max_episode_steps=1000; only then status is task_complete and exit is 0. The 1000-step motion-planning horizon is a Hub recipe condition, not the upstream default benchmark horizon.
